notes.title: True Mining Simulator - 1 year anniversary
notes.content:
Hello
Last week we have reached 1 year since the early access release of True Mining Simulator. Since release we have released 3 major updates and were working despite some unfortunate factors on the biggest update yet – 0.2

[b]First[/b], to celebrate the year of game’s development the True Mining Simulator will be on the biggest discount so far – 12% for 12 months on the run.

[b]Second[/b], let’s check progress on 0.2 update. So far, we can show some things that are still in the works. Unfortunately, 2021 was not a fruitful year for the development team, we’ve run into different life, health, study issues, some people joined us, some people decided to move on. So please note, likely not all features below may get to 0.2 update, because it is still in the works. And based on our recent productivity, it will be some more months before it’s released. So here is what’s planned for 0.2 as of now:
[list]
[*] Visual rework of the room [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31274262/65bb4f068528053f3256458d97509add1648e427.jpg[/img]
[*] Adding more space for True Miner to dwell and some new mechanics together with it [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31274262/b93e241cd4556f3809c6f60153f0e382b4608a40.jpg[/img]
[*] New components are arriving to the market [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31274262/225a5427ad177c0e3f5068aa4017428674c43048.png[/img]
[*] Phone rework – there is more than just one chat [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31274262/a99287e2647f8e94cbbc4e32da5f51687a541e34.jpg[/img]
[*] Video settings will be available for tuning
[*] Some bugfixes
[/list]
Again, thanks for your support for all this time, we will share more news and dates when we will have them. Let’s hope 2022 will be a better year for all of us!

We remind you that you can keep in touch with us through:
[list]
[*] A public Trello board through which you can easily track our priorities and progress [url=https://trello.com/b/AM6Opxnn/true-mining-simulator-public-dev-board]https://trello.com/b/AM6Opxnn/true-mining-simulator-public-dev-board[/url]
[*] Steam Community to communicate with both us and other players in Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/755550/discussions/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/755550/discussions/[/url]
[*] And last but not least, the Discord server where our feedback is the fastest [url=https://discord.gg/jjHRvCw3gm]https://discord.gg/jjHRvCw3gm[/url]
[/list]

[i]Sincerely yours,
Boolba Entertainment[/i]

notes.title: 0.1.6 Fight for your life!
notes.content:
But meanwhile we are introducing 0.1.6 update that will bring some sense into our mining business. Previously you were earning money just for fun, but now you will fight for you life in limited time!

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Final game goal added
[*] Introduced first (but not the last) Steam achievement to salute you in your accomplishments
[*] Game balance tweaks
[/list]
And speaking about our next major update let us share some of the things related to space...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31274262/53e682a3d29627eaf6593f0dc80a61f4a09b1ad0.png[/img]
Another important note we would like to make is that major update will also bring small price increase for our game since all recent updates and this upcoming major update will increase the amount of content available to discover.
So we'll keep you posted on 0.2 major update but for now, let's taste 0.1.6

We remind you that you can keep in touch with us through:

Boolba Entertainment

notes.title: 0.1.5 It's time to rest
notes.content:
This update is focused on... nap time. Yes, now after long and frustrating mining farm assembly you will be able to take a 10 hour long sleep.

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Fatigue mechanic implementation
[*] We've done a small rebalance to better illustrate real world mining with addition of this new mechanic.
[*] Better sound handling in some cases
[*] Improved game pause handling in some menus
[/list]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/FzAdVAI86iQtPETRJK/giphy.gif[/img]

Next updates are already in progress. In particular 0.1.6 will start setting some goals in this senseless rooms of yours. We do our best to keep our promises and that means we'll do our best to make 0.1.6 released next month already. And major update 0.2 is not that far away as well. Stay tuned for more updates!

We remind you that you can keep in touch with us through:

notes.title: The long-awaited 0.1.4 is here
notes.content:
Let's jump right into the changes:
[h3] This update includes several major features:
[/h3][olist]
[*] 	Save game
[*] 	Background music
[*] 	Basic settings menu
[/olist]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/zysF0pns15Ao187EpI/source.gif[/img]
[h3] And some improvements
[/h3][olist]
[*] 	Better data types suitable for bigger scale mining
[*] 	Better numbers rounding to prevent some exchange issues
[*] 	Hunger is not a number now
[*] 	Changed footstep sound
[*] 	Minor gameplay rebalancing
[/olist]
Overall, this update included changing over 150 game files and thousands lines of code. And was really a big deal for us. But now you are going to hear from us more often. 0.1.5 and future updates are already in development. We will reveal more details soon on our next development efforts.

notes.title: Current 0.1.4 update status
notes.content:
[h2]Hey! We would like to share the actual development status of the 0.1.4 update.[/h2] 
At the moment, there are still 2 things in progress:
[olist]
[*] Save game: feels like more than half of the work is ready here.
[*] Updating the control system to the modern version in the game engine we are using. It is close to the final stage right now.
[/olist]
As we wrote earlier, all these changes affect a considerable amount of the existing code that we are reworking. And as you may have already heard, the development of this game is still not our main job :(
[h2]What is already done:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Background music (we look forward to your feedback as the update is released)
[/list]
[h3]Minor updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Another new model from the update after 0.1.4
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31274262/a8cd78ad9271daacff5be80af94b2be5d31ed166.jpg[/img]
[*] Hunger will be displayed as a bar instead of %
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31274262/d30e23cc2b7d6541eedce9ac64a687ce7a16fc71.gif[/img]
[/list]
[h2]Why so long?[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Our performance is currently not at the level we would like it to be. For various reasons. Mostly personal.
[*] Also because of this, among other things, there are (and possibly will still happen) rearrangements of people helping with the project
[/olist]
We hope that the measures we are taking will help solve the current problems, at least partially. The effect of the changes will be fully felt in the update following the upcoming 0.1.4 update
[h2]When the update is coming?[/h2]
We still don't want to give false expectations, so we will declare a date when everything will be ready.

We remind you that you can keep in touch with us through:
[list]
[*] A public Trello board through which you can easily track our priorities and progress [url=https://trello.com/b/AM6Opxnn/true-mining-simulator-public-dev-board]https://trello.com/b/AM6Opxnn/true-mining-simulator-public-dev-board[/url]
[*] Steam Community to communicate with both us and other players in Steam [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/755550/discussions/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/755550/discussions/[/url]
[*] And last but not least, the Discord server where our feedback is the fastest [url=https://discord.gg/jjHRvCw3gm]https://discord.gg/jjHRvCw3gm[/url]
[/list]
[h3]Thank you for being with us all this time,
Boolba Entertainment[/h3]

notes.content:

[list]
[*] saving the game;
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE} /31274262/284e2ec8711a2cbf3d5c95d50ba0d8a7eb55c5d3.gif[/img]

notes.title: Day 2 - Rebalance Patch
notes.content:
Hello
We are very pleased that you've already shared your thoughts on what needs to be improved. So here's one of the things we could've done fast - rebalancing some aspects of the game. Rebalanced items below:
[list]
[*] Electricity bills will be several times lower - let's change country for a one with cheaper electricity
[*] Prices on items change to better reflect real world prices
[*] Minor crypto rates engine tweaks
[*] Though you are not allowed to go out - your hunger will increase a bit
[*] Game time flows a little faster for smoother replays
[/list]
And there's one more important change - we've moved game to the latest major version of it's game engine. After this update we will be able to use latest engine optimizations and some of its updated opportunities. Please let us know if you'll notice any issues.

Our next post will be about how we plan to communicate with our community - please stay tuned! :)

Best regards,
Boolba Entertainment

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tMHm4Mr.png[/img]
